_comment: ADR-0003 D3/D4/D7 chunker parameters. Changing a value needs a new ADR or an amendment with evidence. The key of each arm is the chunker_config used in chunk IDs ({source_id}:{chunker_config}:{index:04d}). stats_small_chunk_chars = the D3 minimum, used by the stats of both arms to count small chunks. drop_heading_only (Arm A only) = ADR-0003 D3a: drop chunks that contain only heading lines.
